interpolation: linear translation and shortest quaternion SLERP per edge

route_provenance.provenance: 2026-09-30: relative separation path derived from the recorded C-space claw motion (assets/tasks/interlocked_claws/cspace_claw_wang_v1/recorded_motion.json, unlock phase 0-105 s) via reference forward kinematics and the piece grasp transforms, mapped to the 0.68-scaled pieces by the similarity about the TCP midpoint; pointwise clearance widened (bounded random hill-climb), then 72 milestones re-connected with a corridor-guided bidirectional RRT; every edge certified at 0.5 mm during construction
route_provenance.hint_provenance: world orientation of claw_0 at the nearest recorded sample (reference frame == world orientation; mount euler 0); used only to bias the coupled IK's common pose
route_provenance.seed_provenance: recorded ALOHA qpos and TCP midpoint (scaled about the TCP midpoint, mount offset added) at the nearest recorded sample; used only as IK seeds and workspace centres
